source.text_it: In un incidente stradale, se non si può spostare il veicolo, bisogna immediatamente segnalare il pericolo

records.localized_text: If an accident vehicle cannot be moved, warn of the danger immediately.

source.text_it: In un incidente stradale senza feriti, bisogna comunque chiamare l'ambulanza telefonando al numero 118

records.localized_text: In a road accident without injuries, an ambulance must nevertheless be called on 118.

source.text_it: La segnalazione di pericolo serve ad allertare i conducenti dei veicoli che sopraggiungono

records.localized_text: Danger warnings alert drivers of approaching vehicles.

source.text_it: La segnalazione di pericolo può essere attuata alzando al massimo il volume dell'autoradio

records.localized_text: Danger can be signalled by turning the car radio to maximum volume.

source.text_it: In un incidente stradale, in caso di versamento di sostanze viscide sulla carreggiata, si deve segnalare il pericolo ai veicoli che sopraggiungono

records.localized_text: After a road accident involving slippery substances spilled on the carriageway, warn approaching vehicles.

source.text_it: In caso di incidente i conducenti dei veicoli coinvolti devono rilevare i danni visibili

records.localized_text: After an accident, the drivers involved must record visible damage.

source.text_it: La segnalazione di pericolo ha lo scopo di impedire il transito nei cantieri stradali

records.localized_text: Danger warnings are intended to prevent traffic through roadworks.

source.text_it: Nel caso di incidente stradale con danni alle sole cose si devono chiamare i Carabinieri

records.localized_text: After a road accident causing only property damage, the Carabinieri must be called.

source.text_it: In caso di incidente, i conducenti dei veicoli coinvolti devono constatare i danni dopo aver liberato la carreggiata

records.localized_text: After an accident, drivers must assess damage after clearing the carriageway.

source.text_it: In un incidente stradale senza feriti si deve cercare di sgomberare la carreggiata per non arrecare pericolo per sé o per gli altri

records.localized_text: In a road accident without injuries, try to clear the carriageway to avoid danger to yourself or others.

source.text_it: La segnalazione di pericolo tramite il segnale di veicolo fermo è inutile in caso di incidente stradale senza feriti

records.localized_text: A stationary-vehicle warning sign is useless after a road accident without injuries.

source.text_it: In caso di incidente i conducenti dei veicoli coinvolti devono rilevare tutti gli elementi utili per ricostruirne la dinamica

records.localized_text: After an accident, drivers must record all information useful for reconstructing what happened.

source.text_it: In caso di incidente occorre sempre fornire le proprie generalità agli altri conducenti coinvolti

records.localized_text: After an accident, one must always provide personal details to the other drivers involved.

source.text_it: La mancanza di copertura assicurativa (RCA) comporta una sanzione a carico del proprietario e dell'utilizzatore del veicolo

records.localized_text: Lack of motor third-party liability insurance results in penalties for the vehicle owner and user.

source.text_it: Il conducente che provoca danni solo materiali in un incidente si libera dall'obbligo del risarcimento rimborsando direttamente il danneggiato

records.localized_text: A driver causing only property damage in an accident is released from the duty to compensate by reimbursing the injured party directly.

source.text_it: I soggetti non trasportati che subiscono un danno dalla circolazione del veicolo sono risarcibili dall'assicurazione RCA (responsabilità civile automobilistica)

records.localized_text: Persons not carried in the vehicle who suffer damage from its use may be compensated by motor third-party liability insurance.

source.text_it: Il conducente che provoca danni solo materiali in un incidente si deve fare assistere da un consulente di investimenti

records.localized_text: A driver causing only property damage in an accident must obtain assistance from an investment adviser.

source.text_it: Il conducente che provoca danni solo materiali in un incidente non è responsabile verso i conducenti danneggiati

records.localized_text: A driver causing only property damage in an accident is not liable to affected drivers.

source.text_it: Il Codice delle assicurazioni private prevede il risarcimento esclusivamente a seguito di sentenza passata in giudicato

records.localized_text: The private insurance code provides compensation only following a final court judgment.

source.text_it: Il conducente che provoca danni solo materiali in un incidente ha una responsabilità civile verso il danneggiato

records.localized_text: A driver causing only property damage in an accident has civil liability to the injured party.

source.text_it: Il furto del carico del veicolo è risarcibile dall'assicurazione RCA (responsabilità civile automobilistica)

records.localized_text: Theft of vehicle cargo is compensable under motor third-party liability insurance.

source.text_it: I danni derivanti alle cose dall'incidente stradale sono risarcibili dall'assicurazione RCA (responsabilità civile automobilistica)

records.localized_text: Property damage arising from a road accident is compensable under motor third-party liability insurance.

source.text_it: I costi di manutenzione ordinaria del veicolo sono risarcibili dall'assicurazione RCA (responsabilità civile automobilistica)

records.localized_text: Routine vehicle maintenance costs are compensable under motor third-party liability insurance.

source.text_it: Il conducente che provoca danni solo materiali in un incidente si può fare assistere da un consulente d'infortunistica stradale

records.localized_text: A driver causing only property damage in an accident may seek assistance from a road accident claims adviser.

source.text_it: Il conducente che provoca danni solo materiali in un incidente non è responsabile verso i terzi trasportati

records.localized_text: A driver causing only property damage in an accident is not liable to passengers carried as third parties.

rows.text: A stopped vehicle can be an unexpected obstacle: warn approaching traffic and make the road safe.
evidence: Regolamento del Codice della strada, art. 356 comma 1, https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/regolamento_codice_della_strada.pdf — presegnalazione immediata dei veicoli incidentati non rimovibili tempestivamente; Codice della strada art. 161 commi 1 e 3, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-161.php — ingombro e segnalazione.

rows.text: 118 is for medical emergencies. If there is only property damage and nobody needs medical help, an ambulance is not required.
evidence: Regione Lombardia, 116117 guidance, section When to call 118 or 112 https://www.regione.lombardia.it/sanita/prenotazioni-e-tempi-d-attesa/numero-europeo-armonizzato-116-117?s=04 — 118/112 for medical emergencies and ambulance dispatch; regional description, not a claim of uniform call routing across Italy.

rows.text: The warning helps approaching drivers notice the obstacle in time and adjust their driving.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 162 comma 1, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-162.php — presegnalazione ai conducenti sopraggiungenti.

rows.text: A car radio does not warn other road users of danger. Use a suitable warning, such as the triangle where required.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 162 commi 1-2, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-162.php — segnale mobile triangolare di pericolo.

rows.text: Slippery substances can make the road dangerous: whoever could not prevent the spill must warn traffic and notify the road authority or police.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 161 commi 2-3, https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/codice_strada.pdf — spargimento di materie viscide, segnalazione e avviso.

rows.text: Recording visible damage helps document the consequences for a compensation claim, while first safeguarding traffic safety.
evidence: IVASS, R.c. auto, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/quesiti/r.c.auto/index.html — richiesta con dati, dinamica e disponibilità del veicolo per accertamento; Codice strada art. 189 comma 2, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-189.php — priorità alla sicurezza.

rows.text: A warning alerts approaching traffic to danger or an obstacle so drivers can respond; it does not necessarily prohibit passage through roadworks.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 161 comma 3 e art. 162 comma 1, https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/codice_strada.pdf — segnalazione di pericolo o intralcio.

rows.text: With only property damage, calling the Carabinieri is not always compulsory: stop, make the scene safe and give affected parties the relevant details.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 189 commi 1-4, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-189.php — obblighi di arresto, sicurezza e dati, senza obbligo generale di chiamata ai Carabinieri.

rows.text: When only property is damaged, clearing the road when possible reduces danger and obstruction; the damage can then be assessed. Protect traffic safety and, where compatible, preserve useful evidence; assist any injured people.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 189(1–3) https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-189/ — protect traffic, preserve useful traces compatibly with safety, and when only property is damaged avoid obstruction where possible; assist injured persons. The printed VERO is compatible with these duties.

rows.text: When only property is damaged, drivers must avoid obstructing traffic; moving vehicles when possible reduces the risk to others.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 189 comma 3, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-189.php — evitare intralcio con soli danni alle cose.

rows.text: The absence of injuries does not make the warning triangle useless. Outside built-up areas, a vehicle stopped on the carriageway, excluding bicycles, two-wheeled mopeds and motorcycles, must be marked when it cannot be seen from behind at a sufficient distance, or at night if its rear position or hazard lights are missing or ineffective.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 162 comma 1, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-162/ — categorie escluse e condizioni distinte di presegnalazione fuori dai centri abitati.

rows.text: Recording circumstances, vehicle positions and witnesses helps reconstruct the accident and assess responsibility, while keeping safety in mind.
evidence: IVASS, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/quesiti/r.c.auto/index.html — richiesta di risarcimento con dinamica e dati; https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/rc-auto/sinistri/index.html — identificazione testimoni.

rows.text: Drivers must give affected parties their personal details and other information useful for compensation, communicating by available means if they are absent.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 189 comma 4, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-189.php — generalità e informazioni utili ai danneggiati.

rows.text: Driving without RCA cover is punishable; the owner may be jointly liable under the conditions laid down by law.
evidence: Codice della strada artt. 193 commi 1-2 e 196 comma 1, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-193.php e https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-196.php — sanzione a chi circola senza copertura e responsabilità solidale del proprietario con le eccezioni previste.

rows.text: If the responsible person directly and fully compensates the damage, they fulfil their obligation to the affected party. RCA is a separate means of covering liability.
evidence: Codice civile art. 2054 comma 1, riprodotto nella Gazzetta Ufficiale 15 maggio 2020, supplemento ordinario n. 19, p. 218 (PDF p. 222), https://pg-salerno.giustizia.it/cmsresources/cms/documents/29%29%2018-05-2020%20Ripubblicazione%20del%20testo_1.pdf — il conducente risarcisce danni a persone o cose salvo prova liberatoria.

Codice civile art. 1181, richiamato nel quesito 082 dell’ACI, https://www.aci.it/laci/la-federazione/amministrazione-trasparente/moduli/downloadFile.php?file=oggetto_allegati%2F173201321120O__OTest+-+Elementi+Diritto+Civile.pdf — il creditore può rifiutare un adempimento parziale; il pagamento integrale della prestazione dovuta ne costituisce adempimento.
IVASS, guida RC, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/imparaconivass/guide/Guida_5_Le_assicurazioni_della_responsabilita_civile_versione_web.pdf — assicurazione della responsabilità verso terzi.

rows.text: RCA covers liability for damage to third parties arising from vehicle use. Affected parties can include people outside the vehicle, subject to applicable limits and exclusions.
evidence: IVASS, contratto base RC auto, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/preventivatore/faq-preventivatore/norme-preventivatore/DM_2020_54.pdf — terzi trasportati e non trasportati, esclusioni e copertura.

rows.text: An investment adviser is not required to handle an accident. Instead, exchange relevant details and follow the appropriate compensation procedures.
evidence: Codice strada art. 189 comma 4, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-189.php; IVASS https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/rc-auto/sinistri/index.html — dati e procedure per il sinistro.

rows.text: Property damage alone can give rise to civil liability to the affected party: the absence of injuries does not remove the duty to compensate.
evidence: Codice civile art. 2054 comma 1, riprodotto nella Gazzetta Ufficiale 15 maggio 2020, supplemento ordinario n. 19, p. 218 (PDF p. 222), https://pg-salerno.giustizia.it/cmsresources/cms/documents/29%29%2018-05-2020%20Ripubblicazione%20del%20testo_1.pdf — il conducente risarcisce danni a persone o cose salvo prova liberatoria.

rows.text: Compensation can also be settled through the insurer’s procedure without waiting for a final court judgment.
evidence: Codice delle assicurazioni art. 148; IVASS, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/rc-auto/sinistri/index.html — procedura di offerta e risarcimento fuori dal giudizio.

rows.text: A person who causes property damage may have to compensate it: civil liability also covers damage to property.
evidence: Codice civile art. 2054 comma 1, riprodotto nella Gazzetta Ufficiale 15 maggio 2020, supplemento ordinario n. 19, p. 218 (PDF p. 222), https://pg-salerno.giustizia.it/cmsresources/cms/documents/29%29%2018-05-2020%20Ripubblicazione%20del%20testo_1.pdf — il conducente risarcisce danni a persone o cose salvo prova liberatoria.

rows.text: RCA covers liability for harm to third parties arising from vehicle use, not theft of the cargo as such. If goods are entrusted to a carrier, any liability the carrier has for their loss is separate and may be covered by specific insurance, subject to the policy terms.
evidence: IVASS, glossario 2021, voci r.c. auto e rami danni 7 e 10, https://www.ivass.it/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/pubblicazioni/relazione-annuale/2022/relazione_2021_glossario.pdf — responsabilità da uso del veicolo e assicurazione merci sono rami distinti.

Vittoria Assicurazioni, DIP Polizza RCV Targhe Identificate 07.25, p. 1, https://storage.googleapis.com/sito-istituzionale-prod/1/2025/07/DB0810300-EDZ-0725.pdf — esempio distinto di responsabilità contrattuale del vettore per furto delle merci affidate; soggetto a condizioni ed esclusioni. Il quesito non precisa la proprietà del carico.

rows.text: RCA also covers property damage caused to third parties by vehicle use, subject to the cover’s limits and exclusions.
evidence: IVASS, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/preventivatore/faq-preventivatore/norme-preventivatore/DM_2020_54.pdf — danni a terzi dalla circolazione e soggetti esclusi.

rows.text: Routine maintenance is a vehicle operating expense, not damage to a third party caused by vehicle use and covered by RCA.
evidence: IVASS, https://www.ivass.it/consumatori/preventivatore/faq-preventivatore/norme-preventivatore/DM_2020_54.pdf — la copertura riguarda danni involontariamente causati a terzi dalla circolazione.

rows.text: A driver who caused only property damage can also consult a road-accident technical expert, who can help assess the damage and circumstances and deal with the claim.
evidence: AICIS, own professional code in association statute, articles 10–12 https://aicis.it/statuto/ — technical vehicle damage and cause assessment; expert objectivity even when instructed by one party and other party’s freedom to hire another expert outside court. Association practice rules, not a statutory guarantee of reimbursement or legal representation.

rows.text: The fact that damage is only material does not exclude liability toward a passenger: their property can also be damaged, subject to any insurance exclusions.
evidence: Codice civile art. 2054 comma 1, riprodotto nella Gazzetta Ufficiale 15 maggio 2020, supplemento ordinario n. 19, p. 218 (PDF p. 222), https://pg-salerno.giustizia.it/cmsresources/cms/documents/29%29%2018-05-2020%20Ripubblicazione%20del%20testo_1.pdf — il conducente risarcisce danni a persone o cose salvo prova liberatoria.
Codice delle assicurazioni art. 129, https://www.ivass.it/normativa/nazionale/primaria/cap.pdf — esclusioni RCA per alcuni danni alle cose.

issues.reason: The explanation restricts the question to property-only accidents and does not explain its stated sequence of assessing damage after clearing the road. Article 189(2)-(3) requires safety and preservation of traces where compatible, with the additional obligation to avoid obstruction where possible for property-only accidents; it does not establish a general rule that damage must be assessed only after clearing. Clarify the scope and sequence against an authoritative source without changing the printed verdict.

Article 162(1) excludes bicycles, two-wheeled mopeds and motorcycles from its triangle requirement, but the explanation states the requirement for an unqualified stopped vehicle. It also describes all statutory cases as poor visibility, omitting the distinct nighttime condition of missing or ineffective rear position or emergency lights. State the applicable categories and conditions accurately.

The question says vehicle cargo, while the explanation assumes the cargo belongs to the vehicle user. The evidence does not establish that inferred ownership or assess liability for third-party cargo. Verify the intended scope with authoritative evidence and record the inference, or explain the distinction without an unsupported assumption.

The cited Law 264/1991 addresses transport-circulation administrative consultancy generally; the cited insurance and CONSAP provisions concern legal-protection cover or an insurance intermediary.
